value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for running work unattended and leaving a record anyone can check
value.lets_workers: Run work overnight or on a schedule with nobody watching, and leave a morning record anyone can check: plan the window and its allowance, get a person's approval, decline what has no check before any model runs, work each candidate in its own copy, let the check grade every attempt on an outcome ladder, keep every failure and write a plain-language report.

flow.when: Before the first unattended run of a plan; a person's verb.
At the start of the window, before any model runs; deterministic.
Once per candidate that is attempted; deterministic.
Once per candidate, inside its own copy and allowance.

guardrails: Nothing runs unattended without a person's approval of scope, window and allowance.
The person's own copy is read for its head and nothing else; every attempt works in its own copy.
The check grades; a worker's account of its own work is never the verdict.
No question can be asked at run time, and nothing is pushed, merged or released by the run.
An empty night is reported as empty, and every failure stays on the record.

value.title: How an unattended run is planned, approved, triaged, worked, graded and reported
value.category_reason: A reusable procedure with guardrails, followed by every verb in this pack.
night_in_order: Intake: candidates come from places people already trust, each with a check that already failed.

Triage, before any model runs: rank by value over effort, fold duplicates, skip recently refuted work and decline with a named reason anything with no runnable check, a check with effects outside the workspace, or a check already passing.
Isolation: each candidate gets its own copy; the person's copy is read only for its head and whether it is clean.
Baseline: run the target check and every other check first, record what was already failing, and hash the check folder and the environment.
Attempts: bounded steps under the step contract, each with its own allowance.
Grading: rerun the checks, rehash, inspect the diff's scope and place the attempt on the outcome ladder.
Delivery: commit on the candidate's branch in its copy. Discarded attempts keep their branches.
Report: every candidate on its rung with evidence, declines with reasons, and a next step for each shortfall.
rules: A run that cannot decline invents work.
No question at run time: a candidate that needs an answer ends as blocked_named with the one question.
Grants and allowances come from the remaining budget, not fixed timeouts.
Unmeasured counters stay empty with a reason; they are never zero.
Workers create nouns and propose verbs; they never enqueue.

value.title: Guards every unattended run checks before and while it works
value.category_reason: Deterministic guard rules checked by the runner.
before_start: A lock: a second run on the same workspace exits at once.
A stop file: when present, the window is skipped and the report says so.
Machine probes named in the plan, such as mains power, idle time and free disk; a failed probe skips the window.
An approval that covers this plan and has not expired.
while_working: Each candidate's allowance comes from what remains of the window, so late candidates get smaller grants and a grant below the floor declines the candidate instead of starting it.
The run writes only to its own copies and its own record store, never to a shared store it does not own.
Resume only within the same window; a missed window is not caught up.
after: Old copies and records are pruned only by the plan's retention rule.
A pipeline step's failure is not hidden by a later command's success: every step's own exit status is recorded.

layers.do: Write a prompt-only result with a ready-to-use handoff and end blocked_named.

rungs.check: Regression set: every check passing at baseline still passes.
Type and contract assertions from signatures.
Generic relations matched to the shape, such as order independence or idempotence.
Comparison with behaviour before the change on unchanged paths.
Property tests from a contract a person wrote.
Mutation testing of the changed file, run before the fix, to measure how strong the check is.
A model's judgment, as a triage signal only and never a gate.

rules: Record each rung as its own result; never merge them into one pass or fail.
Mutation testing measures the check, not the change.
Property tests derived from the code under repair encode its bug; they need a person's contract.
A pass that survived rungs 0 to 4 is a different claim from one that survived rung 0 only.

value.category_reason: A deterministic check suite with known-good and known-bad examples; the validator recomputes every verdict.
value.purpose: Checks every morning report must pass before anyone relies on it. The two made-up good reports pass all of them; each made-up bad report fails exactly the one check named in fails.

deterministic_checks.why: The headline states counts, starting from what is verified.
A morning headline never says everything was fixed; it says how many items reached each rung.
Every candidate sits on one rung with the evidence that put it there.
A declined candidate says why, so declining is a result, not silence.
Each candidate that fell short carries a next step another worker can start from.
A degraded layer is named and recorded on the work it affected, never hidden.
When a check folder changed during an attempt, that attempt is void, however green it looks.
The run commits on branches in its own copies; publishing changes stays a person's act.
Nobody answers during an unattended run; a question means the run was composed wrong.
A counter the harness did not report stays empty with a reason; it is never written as zero.
The morning summary says what happened in plain words; raw machine output stays in the evidence.
